**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User is interested in OctoPrint.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] OctoPrint is a web-based interface for controlling 3D printers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] OctoPrint allows users to monitor and control their 3D printers remotely using a web browser.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Features of OctoPrint include uploading and printing 3D models, viewing and analyzing print bed and extruder temperature in real-time, and starting, stopping, and pausing prints.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] OctoPrint is often used with 3D printers that run the open-source firmware Marlin.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] OctoPrint is typically run on a Raspberry Pi or similar single-board computer.
- [USER] User wants to add Samba and share the watched folder to their local network to a user named Snapmaker.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To add Samba, the user should install it by running `sudo apt-get install samba samba-common-bin`.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should create a new Samba configuration file by running `sudo nano /etc/samba/smb.conf`.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should add specific lines to the Samba configuration file, replacing "/path/to/watched/folder" with the actual path to the watched folder.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The configuration lines include:
  ```
  [OctoPrint]
    comment = OctoPrint Watched Folder
    path = /path/to/watched/folder
    browseable = yes
    read only = no
    guest ok = no
    create mask = 0644
    directory mask = 0755
    force user = pi
  ```
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should save and close the configuration file.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should restart the Samba service by running `sudo service smbd restart`.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should add a Samba user for the Snapmaker user by running `sudo smbpasswd -a Snapmaker`.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should follow prompts to set a password for the Snapmaker user.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] User should be able to access the watched folder from other devices on the local network by browsing to `\[OctoPrint IP address]\OctoPrint`.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Snapmaker user will be able to authenticate with the password set by the user.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offers further assistance if the user has questions.
